title.tl: Ang Pagtatagumpay ng Agham sa Kamatayan

description:
The Triumph of Science Over Death, or Scientia, is one of the three statuettes Rizal made while in London. Scientia depicts a woman holding a burning torch standing on a skull completely naked. In 19th century art, nudity symbolized power, purity, invincibility, the moral character to conquer ignorance through enlightenment.

There are several reproductions of this piece: one by Inocencio Gallemit now displayed in Silid Pamana of the Museo ni Jose Rizal in Fort Santiago; another, a big concrete replica known as Lady Med, stands in front of the Fernando Calderon Hall of the University of the Philippines College of Medicine in Manila; yet another replica, by Dr. Genaro Sy-Changco, can be found in Alabang, Muntinlupa City, in the former Biological Production Services Building (now part of Festival Mall).
